facts.statement: The extinct genus Clovesuurdameredeor means "sea creature of Closworth" and belongs to the machimosaurid teleosauroids.
facts.quote: Clovesuurdameredeor (meaning "sea creature of Closworth"; from the Medieval Latin Clovesuurda and the Old English meredeor) is an extinct genus of machimosaurid teleosauroid from the Bathonian Cornbrash Formation of England.

rejected.statement: Clovesuurdameredeor is an extinct teleosauroid crocodilian that lived in England during the Middle Jurassic.
rejected.quote: Clovesuurdameredeor es un género extinto de crocodiliforme teleosáurido que vivió desde el Jurásico Medio (Bathoniense) en Inglaterra.

rejected.statement: Clovesuurdameredeor is classified within the unranked order Mesoeucrocodylia, the suborder Thalattosuchia, and the family Machimosauridae.
rejected.quote: unranked_ordo: Mesoeucrocodylia subordo: Thalattosuchia familia: Machimosauridae

rejected.statement: The type species C. stephani was originally named by Hulke in 1877 based on a partial skull from the Cornbrash Formation of Dorsetshire, England.
rejected.quote: La especie tipo de Clovesuurdameredeor, C. stephani, fue nombrado por Hulke (1877) como una nueva especie de Steneosaurus, S. stephani, sobre la base de un cráneo parcial de la Formación Cornbrash de Dorsetshire, Inglaterra.

rejected.statement: Johnson and colleagues in 2019 noted differences that distinguished S. stephani from Yvridiosuchus boutilieri, keeping it as a separate taxon.
rejected.quote: Johnson et al. (2019) notaron diferencias con respecto a este último y retuvieron a stephani como un taxón distinto.

rejected.statement: In his 2019 thesis, Johnson discovered that S. stephani was a basal machimosaur and erected the new genus Clovesuurdameredeor for it.
rejected.quote: En su tesis, Johnson (2019) descubrió que S. stephani era un machimosaurio basal, erigiendo el nomen ex dissertationae Clovesuurdameredeor para ello.

rejected.statement: Fossils of Clovesuurdameredeor date to the Bathonian stage.
Clovesuurdameredeor lived between 168.2 and 165.3 million years ago during the Bathonian.
rejected.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Bathonian (168.2 to 165.3 million years ago)

rejected.statement: While Vignaud in 1995 considered S. stephani a synonym of Yvridiosuchus boutilieri, Johnson and colleagues later determined it was a distinct basal machimosaur warranting its own genus.
rejected.quote: Vignaud (1995) considered S. stephani to be a minor synonym of Yvridiosuchus boutilieri (then still in the genus Steneosaurus), but Johnson (2019) and Johnson et al. (2020) discovered that S. stephani was a basal machimosaur that was separate from Yvridiosuchus, erecting the genus Clovesuurdameredeor for this.
